zh: 我的新朋友是澳大利亚人。

en: Russia is the largest country in the world.
zh: 俄罗斯是世界上面积最大的国家。

en: My grandmother is still very active.
zh: 我奶奶仍然很活跃。

en: The volcano is still active.
zh: 这座火山仍是活火山。

en: "Tom wrote the letter" is an active sentence.
zh: “Tom wrote the letter”是主动句。

en: She has ten years of experience in hospital administration.
zh: 她有十年的医院管理经验。

en: The new administration promised to cut taxes.
zh: 新一届政府承诺减税。

en: We need a completely new approach to the problem.
zh: 我们需要用一种全新的方法来解决这个问题。

en: A man approached me and asked for directions.
zh: 一个男人走近我，向我问路。

en: There are several ways of approaching this question.
zh: 处理这个问题有好几种方式。

en: The birds fly south at the approach of winter.
zh: 冬天临近时，鸟儿飞往南方。

en: Her grandfather died of lung cancer last year.
zh: 她的祖父去年死于肺癌。

en: Racism is a cancer in our society.
zh: 种族歧视是我们社会的毒瘤。

en: Every citizen has civil rights that must be protected.
zh: 每个公民都享有必须受到保护的公民权利。

en: They were married in a civil ceremony, not in a church.
zh: 他们举行的是民事婚礼，而不是在教堂结婚。

en: He was angry, but he managed to stay civil.
zh: 他很生气，但还是尽量保持礼貌。

en: We bought cut-price tickets for the afternoon show.
zh: 我们买了下午场的减价票。

en: Would you like to dance with me?
zh: 你愿意和我跳支舞吗？

en: The children learned a traditional dance at school.
zh: 孩子们在学校学了一支传统舞蹈。

en: Are you going to the school dance on Friday?
zh: 你星期五去参加学校舞会吗？

en: The city walls were built for defense.
zh: 城墙是为防御而建的。

en: The defense called a new witness.
zh: 辩方传唤了一名新证人。

en: Our team's defense was very strong last night.
zh: 昨晚我们队的防守非常强。

en: We walked in the direction of the river.
zh: 我们朝着河的方向走去。

en: Read the directions carefully before you start.
zh: 开始之前请仔细阅读说明。

en: The project was completed under her direction.
zh: 这个项目是在她的指导下完成的。

en: My half-brother is ten years older than me.
zh: 我的同父异母哥哥比我大十岁。

en: The country became independent in 1960.
zh: 这个国家于1960年独立。

en: She has been financially independent since she was twenty.
zh: 她从二十岁起就经济独立了。

en: The two studies were completely independent of each other.
zh: 这两项研究彼此完全无关。

en: He stood for election as an independent.
zh: 他以无党派人士身份参加竞选。

en: It takes years to master a foreign language.
zh: 掌握一门外语需要好几年。

en: He is a master of Chinese painting.
zh: 他是中国画大师。

en: The dog waited at the door for its master.
zh: 狗在门口等它的主人。

en: She is studying for a master's in education.
zh: 她正在攻读教育学硕士学位。

en: The master bedroom is at the top of the stairs.
zh: 主卧室在楼梯顶上。

en: None of my friends can come to the party.
zh: 我的朋友没有一个能来参加聚会。

en: The government has an open-door policy on trade.
zh: 政府在贸易上实行门户开放政策。

en: The blacksmith pulled a red-hot piece of iron from the fire.
zh: 铁匠从火里取出一块烧得通红的铁。

en: The team is in red-hot form this season.
zh: 这支队伍本赛季状态火爆。

en: News of the crisis caused a sell-off on the stock market.
zh: 危机的消息引发了股市抛售潮。

en: The sell-off of the state airline raised millions.
zh: 出售国营航空公司筹得了数百万资金。

en: The ship sailed across the ocean.
zh: 那艘船横渡了大海。

en: We can ship the books to you tomorrow.
zh: 我们明天可以把书寄给你。

en: Sorry, that size is out of stock.
zh: 抱歉，那个尺码没有存货了。

en: He bought stock in a small tech company.
zh: 他买了一家小型科技公司的股票。

en: We keep a stock of food in case of emergencies.
zh: 我们储备了一些食物以防紧急情况。

en: Does this shop stock fresh bread?
zh: 这家店卖新鲜面包吗？

en: Good teamwork trumps individual talent.
zh: 良好的团队合作胜过个人天赋。

en: She played a trump and won the game.
zh: 她打出一张王牌，赢了这局。

en: What did you do at the weekend?
zh: 你周末做了什么？

en: They often weekend at their cottage by the lake.
zh: 他们常在湖边的小屋过周末。

en: I wonder why she didn't call me.
zh: 我想知道她为什么没给我打电话。

en: We wondered at the beauty of the mountains.
zh: 我们对群山的美丽惊叹不已。

en: The children watched the fireworks in wonder.
zh: 孩子们惊奇地看着烟花。

en: The Great Wall is one of the wonders of the world.
zh: 长城是世界奇观之一。

en: That was the worst film I've ever seen.
zh: 那是我看过的最糟的电影。

en: Poor families were the worst affected by the floods.
zh: 贫困家庭受洪水影响最严重。

en: Don't worry, the worst is over now.
zh: 别担心，最糟的情况已经过去了。

en: They spent a month travelling across Africa.
zh: 他们花了一个月在非洲各地旅行。

en: We usually visit my grandparents on Sunday.
zh: 我们通常星期天去看望祖父母。

en: The concert last night was awesome!
zh: 昨晚的音乐会棒极了！

en: The awesome power of the storm destroyed many houses.
zh: 风暴惊人的威力摧毁了许多房屋。

en: My brother plays the guitar in a band.
zh: 我哥哥在一个乐队里弹吉他。

en: She tied her hair back with a rubber band.
zh: 她用橡皮筋把头发扎在脑后。

en: A small band of volunteers cleaned up the park.
zh: 一小群志愿者打扫了公园。

en: We spent the whole day on the beach.
zh: 我们在海滩上待了一整天。

en: The fishermen beached their boat and walked home.
zh: 渔民们把船拖上岸，然后走回家。

en: Do you want to pay by card or in cash?
zh: 你想刷卡还是付现金？

en: The company is short of cash this year.
zh: 公司今年资金短缺。

en: I need to go to the bank to cash a cheque.
zh: 我得去银行兑现一张支票。

en: Please speak clearly so everyone can hear you.
zh: 请说清楚，让大家都能听见。

en: Clearly, we need more time to finish this.
zh: 显然，我们需要更多时间来完成这件事。

en: The area has many commercial buildings and offices.
zh: 这个地区有很多商业楼和办公室。

en: Their music has become too commercial.
zh: 他们的音乐变得太商业化了。

en: I hate it when commercials interrupt a film.
zh: 我讨厌电影被广告打断。

en: Her daughter-in-law often helps her with the shopping.
zh: 她的儿媳经常帮她买东西。

en: It takes a lot of effort to learn to play the piano.
zh: 学弹钢琴要花很大力气。

en: In an effort to save money, we stopped eating out.
zh: 为了省钱，我们不再在外面吃饭了。

en: I'm a big fan of detective stories.
zh: 我是侦探小说的忠实爱好者。

en: It's so hot; can you turn on the fan?
zh: 太热了，你能把风扇打开吗？

en: She fanned herself with a newspaper.
zh: 她用报纸给自己扇风。

en: Heavy fighting broke out near the border.
zh: 边境附近爆发了激烈的战斗。

en: Can you imagine living without a phone?
zh: 你能想象没有手机的生活吗？

en: I imagine she'll be tired after the long trip.
zh: 我猜想长途旅行后她会很累。

en: The internet has had a huge impact on our lives.
zh: 互联网对我们的生活产生了巨大影响。

en: The car was badly damaged by the impact.
zh: 汽车在撞击中严重受损。

en: Rising prices have impacted many families.
zh: 物价上涨影响了许多家庭。

en: I feel tired because of lack of sleep.
zh: 由于睡眠不足，我觉得很累。

en: He lacks confidence when speaking in public.
zh: 他在公共场合讲话时缺乏自信。

en: Have you heard their latest song?
zh: 你听过他们的最新歌曲吗？

en: He suffered multiple injuries in the accident.
zh: 他在事故中多处受伤。

en: Twelve is a multiple of three.
zh: 十二是三的倍数。

en: The machine is simple in operation.
zh: 这台机器操作简单。

en: She needs an operation on her knee.
zh: 她的膝盖需要做手术。

en: The rescue operation lasted three days.
zh: 救援行动持续了三天。

en: She works for a charity organization.
zh: 她在一个慈善机构工作。

en: The organization of the trip took weeks.
zh: 筹备这次旅行花了好几个星期。

en: Wear a hat to protect your face from the sun.
zh: 戴顶帽子，保护你的脸不被太阳晒伤。

en: Can you keep a secret?
zh: 你能保守秘密吗？

en: They had a secret meeting after school.
zh: 他们放学后开了一次秘密会议。

en: What's the secret of your success?
zh: 你成功的秘诀是什么？

en: He has a senior position in the bank.
zh: 他在银行担任高级职位。

en: The town has many services for senior citizens.
zh: 这个镇为老年人提供了很多服务。

en: My sister is a senior at high school this year.
zh: 我姐姐今年是高中毕业班学生。

en: The museum offers free entry to seniors.
zh: 博物馆对老年人免费开放。

en: The flowers come out in spring.
zh: 花在春天开放。

en: One of the springs in the bed is broken.
zh: 床里有一根弹簧坏了。

en: The village gets its water from a mountain spring.
zh: 村子的水来自一眼山泉。

en: The cat sprang onto the table.
zh: 猫一下子跳到了桌子上。

en: Her silence was a telling sign that she was upset.
zh: 她的沉默很能说明她心里不高兴。

en: The story got funnier with each telling.
zh: 这个故事每讲一次都更好笑。

en: She was wearing a red dress.
zh: 她穿着一条红裙子。

en: The carpet has worn thin near the door.
zh: 门口附近的地毯已经磨薄了。

en: The shop sells children's wear.
zh: 这家店卖童装。

en: The sofa shows signs of wear.
zh: 沙发有磨损的痕迹。

en: We always spend Christmas with our family.
zh: 我们总是和家人一起过圣诞节。

en: We had Indian food for dinner.
zh: 我们晚饭吃的是印度菜。

en: My neighbour is an Indian who moved here from Delhi.
zh: 我的邻居是从德里搬来的印度人。

en: The museum has a collection of American Indian art.
zh: 博物馆收藏了一批美洲印第安人的艺术品。

en: Please write your name and address on the form.
zh: 请在表格上写下你的姓名和地址。

en: The government must address the problem of housing.
zh: 政府必须解决住房问题。

en: The head teacher addressed the whole school.
zh: 校长向全校师生讲话。

en: The president gave an address to the nation.
zh: 总统向全国发表了讲话。

en: The analysis of the data took several weeks.
zh: 数据分析花了好几个星期。

en: It was raining, but we went out anyway.
zh: 下着雨，但我们还是出去了。

en: Anyway, I have to go now. See you tomorrow.
zh: 总之，我现在得走了。明天见。

en: You can choose any book you like.
zh: 你可以挑选任何一本你喜欢的书。

en: She chose to stay at home that evening.
zh: 那天晚上她决定待在家里。

en: What's your favorite color?
zh: 你最喜欢什么颜色？

en: Nobody should be judged by the color of their skin.
zh: 任何人都不应因肤色而被评判。

en: The children colored the pictures with crayons.
zh: 孩子们用蜡笔给图画涂色。

en: His bad experience colored his view of the city.
zh: 他的糟糕经历影响了他对这座城市的看法。

en: A commission was set up to study the problem.
zh: 成立了一个委员会来研究这个问题。

en: She earns a commission on every car she sells.
zh: 她每卖出一辆车就能拿到提成。

en: The city commissioned a new statue for the park.
zh: 市政府委托制作了一座新雕像放在公园里。

en: He won first prize in a singing competition.
zh: 他在一次歌唱比赛中获得一等奖。

en: There is strong competition for jobs in this city.
zh: 这座城市的就业竞争很激烈。

en: We need to find out what the competition is doing.
zh: 我们需要弄清楚竞争对手在做什么。

en: Is there a direct flight to London?
zh: 有直飞伦敦的航班吗？

en: She is very direct and always says what she thinks.
zh: 她很直率，总是有什么说什么。

en: A police officer was directing the traffic.
zh: 一名警察在指挥交通。

en: The film was directed by a young woman.
zh: 这部电影是由一位年轻女性执导的。

en: This train goes direct to the airport.
zh: 这趟火车直达机场。

en: I had a strange dream last night.
zh: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。

en: Her dream is to become a doctor.
zh: 她的梦想是成为一名医生。

en: I dreamed about my old school.
zh: 我梦见了我以前的学校。

en: He dreams of travelling around the world.
zh: 他梦想着环游世界。

en: She passed the exam easily.
zh: 她轻松地通过了考试。

en: This is easily the best pizza in town.
zh: 这无疑是城里最好的比萨。

en: Have you finished your homework yet?
zh: 你做完作业了吗？

en: Finish your milk before you leave the table.
zh: 离开饭桌前把牛奶喝完。

en: It was a close race from start to finish.
zh: 这场比赛从开始到结束都很激烈。

en: The table has a smooth, shiny finish.
zh: 这张桌子表面光滑发亮。

en: They stayed in a grand old hotel by the sea.
zh: 他们住在海边一家宏伟的老酒店里。

en: He has grand plans for the future.
zh: 他对未来有宏大的计划。

en: The car cost him ten grand.
zh: 这辆车花了他一万块。

en: The word "breakfast" literally means "to break a fast".
zh: "breakfast"这个词字面上的意思是"打破禁食"。

en: I was literally dying of hunger.
zh: 我简直要饿死了。

en: They had a low-key wedding with just a few friends.
zh: 他们只请了几个朋友，办了个低调的婚礼。

en: I low-key want to stay home tonight.
zh: 我今晚有点想待在家里。

en: Many low-paid workers can't afford to rent a flat.
zh: 许多低薪工人租不起公寓。

en: Good luck with your exam tomorrow!
zh: 祝你明天考试好运！

en: We lucked out and found a parking space right away.
zh: 我们很走运，马上就找到了停车位。

en: They have a long and happy marriage.
zh: 他们的婚姻长久而幸福。

en: The marriage took place in a small church.
zh: 婚礼在一座小教堂里举行。

en: Is it necessary to book a table?
zh: 需要订座吗？

en: Higher prices are a necessary result of rising costs.
zh: 价格上涨是成本增加的必然结果。

en: He became rich by selling houses.
zh: 他靠卖房子发了财。

en: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.
zh: 橙子富含维生素C。

en: This chocolate cake is too rich for me.
zh: 这个巧克力蛋糕对我来说太腻了。

en: He helped them purely out of self-interest.
zh: 他帮助他们纯粹是出于私利。

en: The army tested a new short-range missile.
zh: 军队试射了一种新型短程导弹。

en: The short-range weather forecast looks good.
zh: 短期天气预报看起来不错。

en: This cream is good for dry skin.
zh: 这种乳霜对干性皮肤很好。

en: Don't eat the skin of the banana.
zh: 别吃香蕉皮。

en: He fell and skinned his knee.
zh: 他摔了一跤，擦破了膝盖的皮。

en: She is good at public speaking.
zh: 她擅长公开演讲。

en: The speaking test lasts ten minutes.
zh: 口语考试持续十分钟。

en: You're supposed to be at school by eight.
zh: 你应该在八点前到学校。

en: The supposed expert knew very little about the subject.
zh: 那位所谓的专家对这个题目知之甚少。

en: This tea is too sweet for me.
zh: 这茶对我来说太甜了。

en: It was sweet of you to remember my birthday.
zh: 你记得我的生日，真贴心。

en: The children were given sweets after the show.
zh: 演出结束后孩子们得到了糖果。

en: What would you like for sweet?
zh: 你甜点想吃什么？

en: He didn't study, and thus he failed the test.
zh: 他没有学习，因此考试没及格。

en: Fold the paper thus, and you'll get a bird.
zh: 像这样把纸折起来，你就能折出一只鸟。

en: Please don't touch the paintings.
zh: 请不要触摸画作。

en: We were deeply touched by her kind letter.
zh: 她亲切的来信让我们深受感动。

en: The fabric is soft to the touch.
zh: 这种布料摸起来很柔软。

en: Let's keep in touch after you move.
zh: 你搬走以后我们保持联系吧。

en: Add a touch of salt to the soup.
zh: 在汤里加一点盐。

en: The film was a world-wide success.
zh: 这部电影在全球大获成功。

en: The company sells its products world-wide.
zh: 这家公司在全世界销售产品。

en: I saw Anna yesterday.
zh: 我昨天见到了安娜。

en: Yesterday was my birthday.
zh: 昨天是我的生日。

en: Today's phones make yesterday's computers look slow.
zh: 如今的手机让过去的电脑显得很慢。

en: My cousin is studying in Germany.
zh: 我表哥在德国读书。

en: Keep the window closed; it's cold outside.
zh: 把窗户关着，外面很冷。

en: The museum is closed on Mondays.
zh: 博物馆星期一闭馆。

en: They live in a very closed community.
zh: 他们生活在一个非常封闭的社区里。

en: She fell in love with her co-star during filming.
zh: 拍摄期间她爱上了与她合演的男明星。

en: He co-starred with his wife in a comedy.
zh: 他和妻子联袂主演了一部喜剧。

en: The new law was passed by Congress.
zh: 这项新法律由国会通过。

en: Doctors from forty countries attended the congress.
zh: 来自四十个国家的医生出席了这次大会。

en: The storm caused serious damage to the roof.
zh: 暴风雨对屋顶造成了严重损坏。

en: Smoking can damage your health.
zh: 吸烟会损害你的健康。

en: She was awarded damages for her injuries.
zh: 她因受伤获得了赔偿金。

en: You should speak to the manager directly.
zh: 你应该直接跟经理谈。

en: The bank is directly opposite the station.
zh: 银行正对着车站。

en: I'll be with you directly.
zh: 我马上就来。

en: Heart disease is a common cause of death.
zh: 心脏病是常见的死因。

en: You should see a doctor about that cough.
zh: 你那咳嗽应该去看看医生。

en: She is a doctor of philosophy.
zh: 她是哲学博士。

en: Someone had doctored the photos.
zh: 有人篡改过这些照片。

en: There is no doubt that he is telling the truth.
zh: 毫无疑问他说的是实话。

en: I doubt that she will come today.
zh: 我怀疑她今天不会来。

en: You should drink more water.
zh: 你应该多喝水。

en: He doesn't drink, so he'll drive us home.
zh: 他不喝酒，所以他会开车送我们回家。

en: Can I get you a drink?
zh: 要给你拿杯饮料吗？

en: Let's go for a drink after work.
zh: 下班后我们去喝一杯吧。

en: Driving in the city centre is stressful.
zh: 在市中心开车很让人紧张。

en: She was the driving force behind the project.
zh: 她是这个项目的推动者。

en: We walked home through the driving rain.
zh: 我们冒着瓢泼大雨走回家。

en: It is an established fact that smoking causes cancer.
zh: 吸烟致癌是公认的事实。

en: The Church of England is the established church.
zh: 英格兰教会是国教。

en: We saw lots of colourful fish in the sea.
zh: 我们在海里看到了很多五颜六色的鱼。

en: We had fish and rice for dinner.
zh: 我们晚饭吃的是鱼和米饭。

en: My dad likes to fish in the river.
zh: 我爸爸喜欢在河里钓鱼。

en: She fished in her bag for her keys.
zh: 她在包里摸找钥匙。

en: He told his parents that he was gay.

en: My fingers were sticky after eating the honey cake.
zh: 吃完蜂蜜蛋糕后，我的手指黏糊糊的。

en: It was a hot, sticky night and nobody could sleep.
zh: 那是个闷热的夜晚，谁也睡不着。

en: Asking for a pay rise can be a sticky situation.
zh: 要求加薪可能是件棘手的事。

en: A bee stung me on the hand while I was in the garden.
zh: 我在花园里的时候，一只蜜蜂蜇了我的手。

en: The smoke made my eyes sting.
zh: 烟熏得我眼睛刺痛。

en: She put some cream on the wasp sting.
zh: 她在被黄蜂蜇的地方抹了些药膏。

en: The thieves were caught in a police sting at the car park.
zh: 小偷们在停车场的一次警方诱捕行动中落网。

en: The room was not sufficiently large for the whole class.
zh: 这个房间不够大，容不下全班同学。

en: Thankfully, nobody was hurt in the accident.
zh: 幸好在事故中没有人受伤。

en: She smiled thankfully at the nurse who had helped her.
zh: 她感激地向帮过她的护士微笑。

en: Put a tick next to the correct answer.
zh: 在正确答案旁边打个勾。

en: Please tick the box if you want to receive our newsletter.
zh: 如果你想收到我们的简报，请在方框内打勾。

en: The room was so quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.
zh: 房间里安静得我能听见钟在滴答作响。

en: The only sound was the tick of the kitchen clock.
zh: 唯一的声音是厨房时钟的滴答声。

en: After walking in the forest, check your dog for ticks.
zh: 在森林里散步后，检查一下你的狗身上有没有蜱虫。

en: I watched an online tutorial on how to fix my bike.
zh: 我看了一个网上教程，学习怎么修自行车。

en: We have a tutorial with our history professor every Friday.
zh: 我们每周五都有一节历史教授的辅导课。

en: Today is my parents' twentieth wedding anniversary.
zh: 今天是我父母结婚二十周年纪念日。

en: Each share is worth one twentieth of the total prize.
zh: 每一份相当于总奖金的二十分之一。

en: The medicine has an unpleasant taste.
zh: 这药味道难闻。

en: The man at the desk was very unpleasant to us.
zh: 前台那个男人对我们很不友好。

en: The two events seemed to be completely unrelated.
zh: 这两件事看起来毫无关联。

en: Although they look alike, the two boys are unrelated.
zh: 这两个男孩虽然长得像，但并没有亲属关系。

en: Is this seat vacant, or is someone sitting here?
zh: 这个座位空着吗，还是有人坐？

en: The post of head teacher has been vacant since June.
zh: 校长一职从六月起一直空缺。

en: He stared out of the window with a vacant expression.
zh: 他神情茫然地盯着窗外。

en: Hot air escapes through a vent in the roof.
zh: 热空气从屋顶的通风口排出。

en: She called her sister to vent her anger about work.
zh: 她打电话给姐姐，发泄对工作的不满。

en: There are several good restaurants in the vicinity of the station.
zh: 车站附近有好几家不错的餐馆。

en: She looked wan and tired after weeks of illness.
zh: 病了几个星期后，她看上去面色苍白、十分疲惫。

en: He gave us a wan smile and said nothing.
zh: 他勉强朝我们笑了笑，什么也没说。

en: Hang your coat in the wardrobe.
zh: 把你的外套挂进衣柜里。

en: She bought a whole new wardrobe for her new job.
zh: 她为新工作添置了一整套新衣服。

en: We sat by the fire and enjoyed its warmth.
zh: 我们坐在火炉边，享受着它的温暖。

en: The family welcomed us with great warmth.
zh: 这家人非常热情地欢迎了我们。

en: The company follows ISO standards for quality control.
zh: 这家公司在质量控制方面遵循国际标准化组织的标准。

en: Use a higher ISO when you take photos in low light.
zh: 在光线暗的地方拍照时，要调高感光度。

en: We saw amazing waterfalls on our trip to Iceland.
zh: 我们去冰岛旅行时看到了壮观的瀑布。

en: Many Latinos in the city speak both Spanish and English.
zh: 这座城市里的许多拉美裔居民既说西班牙语也说英语。

en: The festival celebrates Latino music and food.
zh: 这个节日以拉美音乐和美食为主题。

en: Thousands of visitors go to the Vatican every day.
zh: 每天都有成千上万的游客前往梵蒂冈。

en: He used an axe to chop wood for the fire.
zh: 他用斧头劈柴生火。

en: The company plans to axe 200 jobs next year.
zh: 公司计划明年裁减200个职位。

en: With her red dress, Anna was the belle of the ball.
zh: 安娜穿着红裙子，成了舞会上最美的女子。

en: She texted, "Going to the cinema with my BF tonight."
zh: 她发短信说：“今晚和男友去看电影。”

en: We heard the news on the six o'clock bulletin.
zh: 我们是在六点钟的新闻快报里听到这则消息的。

en: The club sends a monthly bulletin to all its members.
zh: 俱乐部每月给所有会员寄一份会刊。

en: The country moved towards a capitalist economy in the 1990s.
zh: 这个国家在二十世纪九十年代转向了资本主义经济。

en: In the film, he plays a rich capitalist who owns several factories.
zh: 他在影片中扮演一个拥有好几家工厂的富有资本家。

en: Be cautious when you drive on icy roads.
zh: 在结冰的路面上开车要小心。

en: A police constable stopped the car and spoke to the driver.
zh: 一名警员拦下汽车，和司机说了几句话。

en: The two schools cooperated to organise the sports day.
zh: 两所学校合作组织了运动会。

en: The driver cooperated fully with the police.
zh: 司机全力配合了警方。

en: The school counselor helped me choose my university courses.
zh: 学校辅导员帮我选了大学课程。

en: The judge asked the counselor for the defence to sit down.
zh: 法官请辩方律师坐下。

en: The government wants to curb rising prices.
zh: 政府希望抑制物价上涨。

en: The new law puts a curb on smoking in public places.
zh: 新法律对在公共场所吸烟加以限制。

en: He parked the car too close to the curb.
zh: 他把车停得离路缘太近了。

en: She felt she was destined to become a doctor.
zh: 她觉得自己注定要当医生。

en: The ship was destined for a port in Spain.
zh: 这艘船是开往西班牙一个港口的。

en: They live in a large detached house with a garden.
zh: 他们住在一栋带花园的大型独栋房子里。

en: He watched the argument in a calm, detached way.
zh: 他冷静而超然地看着这场争吵。

en: The teacher distributed the test papers to the class.
zh: 老师把试卷分发给全班同学。

en: The company distributes its products to shops across Europe.
zh: 这家公司向全欧洲的商店分销产品。

en: Spread the butter so it is evenly distributed over the bread.
zh: 把黄油抹开，让它均匀地分布在面包上。

en: We changed our dollars into dong when we arrived in Hanoi.
zh: 我们一到河内就把美元换成了越南盾。

en: We heard the deep dong of the church bell.
zh: 我们听到教堂钟发出低沉的当当声。

en: The dictionary lists "dong" as a rude slang word for a penis.
zh: 词典将“dong”列为指阴茎的粗俗俚语。

en: The new machine works much more efficiently than the old one.
zh: 新机器的运转效率比旧机器高得多。

en: Thanks to her teacher's encouragement, she entered the competition.
zh: 在老师的鼓励下，她参加了比赛。

en: The party split into two factions over the issue.
zh: 该党在这个问题上分裂成两个派系。

en: The film is about a young man who joins a group of fascists.
zh: 这部影片讲的是一个加入法西斯分子团伙的年轻人。

en: The country was ruled by a fascist government during the war.
zh: 战争期间，这个国家由法西斯政府统治。

en: My boss is a bit of a fascist about keeping the office tidy.
zh: 在保持办公室整洁这件事上，我的老板有点专横。

en: He lost all his money gambling on horse races.
zh: 他赌赛马输光了所有的钱。

en: They gambled on the weather staying dry for the wedding.
zh: 他们冒险押注婚礼那天不会下雨。

en: Moving to a new city without a job was a big gamble.
zh: 没找到工作就搬到新城市是一场很大的冒险。

en: The goalkeeper caught the ball and threw it to a teammate.
zh: 守门员接住球，扔给了一名队友。

en: Don't worry, this spider is completely harmless.
zh: 别担心，这只蜘蛛完全无害。

en: If you need any help, don't hesitate to ask.
zh: 如果需要帮忙，尽管开口。

en: We are hopeful that the weather will improve by the weekend.
zh: 我们希望到周末天气会好转。

en: The doctor's latest report is very hopeful.
zh: 医生的最新报告很令人鼓舞。

en: Hundreds of young hopefuls came to the singing audition.
zh: 数百名怀揣梦想的年轻人来参加歌唱试镜。

en: In the comedy, "horny" is used as slang for feeling sexually excited.
zh: 在这部喜剧里，“horny”被用作表示性冲动的俚语。

en: The old farmer's hands were rough and horny from years of work.
zh: 老农的双手因多年劳作而粗糙坚硬，像角质一样。

en: Good hygiene, like washing your hands, helps prevent illness.
zh: 良好的卫生习惯，比如洗手，有助于预防疾病。

en: When she was little, she had an imaginary friend called Bobo.
zh: 她小时候有一个名叫波波的想象中的朋友。

en: His story was inconsistent with what the witnesses said.
zh: 他的说法与证人的说法不一致。

en: The team's performance has been very inconsistent this season.
zh: 这个赛季球队的表现很不稳定。

en: My little brother goes to kindergarten every morning.
zh: 我弟弟每天早上去幼儿园。

en: The baby was crying loudly in the next room.
zh: 婴儿在隔壁房间大声哭闹。

en: The mechanic said my car needs new brakes.
zh: 机修工说我的车需要换新刹车。

en: The game has a simple mechanic: jump to avoid the rocks.
zh: 这款游戏的玩法很简单：跳起来躲开石头。

en: We modified the recipe to use less sugar.
zh: 我们调整了食谱，少放些糖。

en: In "a red car", the adjective "red" modifies the noun "car".
zh: 在“a red car”中，形容词“red”修饰名词“car”。

en: He was so busy that he neglected his family.
zh: 他忙得忽视了家人。

en: The old house had fallen into neglect.
zh: 那座老房子已经年久失修。

en: She neglected to tell us that the meeting had moved.
zh: 她忘了告诉我们会议已经改了时间。

en: They live in a small town in northwestern England.
zh: 他们住在英格兰西北部的一个小镇上。

en: The people suffered years of oppression under the king.
zh: 在国王统治下，人民受了多年的压迫。

en: She felt a sense of oppression in the dark, crowded room.
zh: 在那间昏暗拥挤的房间里，她感到一阵压抑。

en: Fans sang patriotic songs before the big match.
zh: 大赛开始前，球迷们唱起了爱国歌曲。

en: The pitcher threw the ball so fast that the batter missed it.
zh: 投手投球太快，击球手没打着。

en: She put a pitcher of lemonade on the table.
zh: 她把一大壶柠檬水放在桌上。

en: The children ran out to the playground at break time.
zh: 课间休息时，孩子们跑到操场上去玩。

en: The island has become a playground for the rich.
zh: 这座岛已成为富人的游乐胜地。

en: We must fight racial prejudice wherever we find it.
zh: 无论在哪里发现种族偏见，我们都必须与之斗争。

en: Don't let one bad experience prejudice you against the whole city.
zh: 别因为一次不好的经历就对整座城市有偏见。

en: Being late again could prejudice your chances of getting the job.
zh: 再迟到可能会影响你得到这份工作的机会。

en: Heavy rain is the most probable cause of the flooding.
zh: 大雨是这次洪水最可能的原因。

en: He is a probable for the national team next month.
zh: 他很可能入选下个月的国家队。

en: Instead of going to prison, he was put on probation for two years.
zh: 他没有坐牢，而是被判缓刑两年。

en: New staff are on probation for the first three months.
zh: 新员工前三个月是试用期。

en: Sales projections for next year look very good.
zh: 明年的销售预测看起来很不错。

en: The projection of the film onto the big screen was very clear.
zh: 电影投射到大银幕上的画面非常清晰。

en: The climber held on to a small rock projection.
zh: 登山者抓住了一块凸出的小岩石。

en: A raven sat on the castle wall and cried loudly.
zh: 一只渡鸦站在城堡墙上大声啼叫。

en: She had long raven hair and dark eyes.
zh: 她有一头乌黑发亮的长发和一双黑眼睛。

en: The drug works by blocking certain receptors in the brain.
zh: 这种药通过阻断大脑中某些受体发挥作用。

en: After years of drinking, he finally agreed to go to rehab.
zh: 酗酒多年后，他终于同意去戒酒中心接受治疗。

en: The footballer is doing rehab after his knee operation.
zh: 这名足球运动员膝盖手术后正在做康复训练。

en: The remake is not as good as the original film.
zh: 这部翻拍片不如原版好。

en: They plan to remake the old cartoon with modern effects.
zh: 他们计划用现代特效翻拍这部老动画片。

en: The lesson explained the reproduction of plants.
zh: 这节课讲解了植物的繁殖。

en: The painting in the hall is only a reproduction.
zh: 大厅里那幅画只是一件复制品。

en: This speaker gives excellent sound reproduction.
zh: 这款音箱的声音还原效果非常好。

en: We had grilled shrimp and rice for dinner.
zh: 我们晚餐吃了烤虾和米饭。

en: When I was at school, the bigger boys called me a shrimp.
zh: 我上学时，大个子男孩们叫我小矮子。

en: A spokesman for the hospital said the patient was doing well.
zh: 医院发言人说病人情况良好。

en: She sells fresh vegetables from a stall in the market.
zh: 她在市场的一个摊位上卖新鲜蔬菜。

en: The car stalled at the traffic lights.
zh: 汽车在红绿灯前熄火了。

en: Talks between the two sides have stalled again.
zh: 双方的谈判又陷入了停滞。

en: The horse was led back into its stall.
zh: 马被牵回了它的畜栏。

en: The strap on my bag broke.
zh: 我包上的带子断了。

en: Make sure the baby is strapped into the car seat.
zh: 一定要把宝宝在汽车座椅上系牢。

en: Whether a film is good or not is very subjective.
zh: 一部电影好不好是很主观的。

en: The house is surrounded by tall trees.
zh: 房子四周环绕着高大的树木。

en: The fireplace has a beautiful stone surround.
zh: 壁炉有一圈漂亮的石头围边。

en: It took the cat a few days to get used to its new surroundings.
zh: 猫花了几天时间才适应新环境。

en: The new manager made sweeping changes to the company.
zh: 新经理对公司进行了全面的改革。

en: It's a sweeping statement to say all teenagers are lazy.
zh: 说所有青少年都懒惰未免太笼统了。

en: He pointed to the hills with a sweeping movement of his arm.
zh: 他大幅度地挥动手臂，指向那片山丘。

en: Losing her father was a traumatic experience for her.
zh: 失去父亲对她来说是一次痛苦的经历。

en: He was treated for a traumatic brain injury after the crash.
zh: 车祸后，他接受了脑外伤治疗。

en: The country's debt is now over two trillion dollars.
zh: 该国的债务现已超过两万亿美元。

en: The long walk really tuckered the kids out.
zh: 长途步行让孩子们筋疲力尽。

en: Let's stop and get some tucker before we drive on.
zh: 我们停下来吃点东西再继续开吧。

en: We bought ice cream from a street vendor.
zh: 我们从街头小贩那里买了冰淇淋。

en: The school is looking for a new software vendor.
zh: 学校正在寻找新的软件供应商。

en: The file is about 5 MB, so you can email it.
zh: 这个文件大约5兆字节，你可以用电子邮件发送。

en: The museum has a large collection of aboriginal art.
zh: 这家博物馆收藏了大量土著艺术品。

en: The land has belonged to the aboriginals for thousands of years.
zh: 这片土地几千年来一直属于原住民。

en: The wheels of the car are out of alignment.
zh: 汽车的车轮没有校准。

en: The country's alignment with its neighbours made it stronger.
zh: 与邻国结盟使这个国家更加强大。

en: I'm allergic to cats, so I start sneezing near them.
zh: 我对猫过敏，一靠近它们就打喷嚏。

en: My brother is allergic to hard work!
zh: 我哥哥对辛苦工作简直“过敏”！

en: Firefighters wear breathing apparatus in smoky buildings.
zh: 消防员在浓烟弥漫的建筑里佩戴呼吸器。

en: The state apparatus was slow to respond to the crisis.
zh: 国家机构对这场危机反应迟缓。

en: I put my books and water bottle in my backpack.
zh: 我把书和水瓶放进了双肩包。

en: After university, she backpacked around South America.
zh: 大学毕业后，她背包游遍了南美洲。

en: We had breakfast on the balcony in the sunshine.
zh: 我们在阳台上沐着阳光吃早餐。

en: Our seats were in the balcony, so we had a good view of the stage.
zh: 我们的座位在楼厅，所以能清楚地看到舞台。

en: Her father was a successful banker in London.
zh: 她父亲曾是伦敦一位成功的银行家。

en: Lying on the beach with a good book was pure bliss.
zh: 躺在海滩上看一本好书真是无比幸福。

en: Sleeping and eating are basic bodily needs.
zh: 睡觉和吃饭是基本的身体需求。

en: The guards lifted him bodily and carried him out.
zh: 保安把他整个人抬起来，抬了出去。

en: The trees act as a buffer against the wind.
zh: 这些树起到了挡风的屏障作用。

en: The video stopped while the buffer was loading.
zh: 缓冲区加载时视频停住了。

en: Savings can buffer you against sudden money problems.
zh: 积蓄可以帮你缓冲突如其来的经济困难。

en: The book was a collaborative project between two artists.
zh: 这本书是两位艺术家的合作项目。

en: The airline compensated passengers for the long delay.
zh: 航空公司对长时间延误的乘客进行了赔偿。

en: Her hard work compensates for her lack of experience.
zh: 她的勤奋弥补了经验的不足。

en: Thank you for your constructive comments on my essay.
zh: 谢谢你对我的文章提出建设性的意见。

en: Scientists study cosmic rays that come from distant stars.
zh: 科学家研究来自遥远恒星的宇宙射线。

en: To a small child, a broken toy can seem like a problem of cosmic importance.
zh: 对小孩子来说，玩具坏了可能就像天大的事。

en: The field was full of daisies in spring.
zh: 春天，田野里开满了雏菊。

en: We need a definite answer by Friday.
zh: 我们需要在周五前得到明确的答复。

en: She was quite definite that she had locked the door.
zh: 她很肯定自己锁了门。

en: The clinic helps children with developmental problems.
zh: 这家诊所帮助有发育问题的儿童。

en: We went to a disco on Saturday night.
zh: 我们周六晚上去了迪厅。

en: My parents still love dancing to disco.
zh: 我父母仍然喜欢跟着迪斯科音乐跳舞。

en: I can't work with all these distractions around me.
zh: 周围这么多干扰，我没法工作。

en: Reading was a welcome distraction during the long winter.
zh: 在漫长的冬天里，读书是一种很好的消遣。

en: The scissors are in the top drawer of my desk.
zh: 剪刀在我书桌最上面的抽屉里。

en: The oil spill caused serious ecological damage.
zh: 石油泄漏造成了严重的生态破坏。

en: They try to live in an ecological way, using little plastic.
zh: 他们尽量过环保的生活，很少使用塑料。

en: Pollution is harming the ecosystem of the lake.
zh: 污染正在破坏这个湖泊的生态系统。

en: Women were once excluded from the club.
zh: 这个俱乐部曾经不接纳女性。

en: The price excludes tax and delivery.
zh: 这个价格不包括税费和运费。

en: Children under five are exempt from the entrance fee.
zh: 五岁以下儿童免收门票。

en: His bad back exempted him from military service.
zh: 他因背部有毛病而被免除兵役。

en: There was a faint smell of smoke in the room.

zh: 乐队用较慢的速度演奏了这首歌。

en: These rules apply to the building and any part thereof.
zh: 这些规定适用于该建筑及其任何部分。

zh: 我渴了，能给我点水吗？

en: We used a torch to find our way in the dark.
zh: 我们用手电筒在黑暗中找路。

zh: 有人在停车场放火烧了一辆旧车。

zh: 这辆车装有涡轮增压器以提高动力。

en: The instructions are clear and understandable.

zh: 请在座位上坐直。

en: Keep the bottle in an upright position.
zh: 让瓶子保持直立。

zh: 他为人正直诚实。

zh: 球击中门柱弹了出去。

en: The army crushed the uprising.
zh: 军队镇压了起义。

zh: 他们试图挽救那棵老树，却是徒劳。

zh: 他非常自恋，每经过一面镜子都要照一照。

zh: 虚荣心让他不肯戴眼镜。

zh: 她在我耳边悄悄说了些什么。

zh: 她头脑很善于分析，喜欢解决问题。

en: The survey asks about age, gender and ethnicity.
zh: 这项调查询问年龄、性别和族裔。

en: Nobody predicted the team's eventual victory.

zh: 她擅长数学和科学。

en: He excelled all the other students in the exam.

en: Firstly, I'd like to thank you all for coming.

zh: 狮子和老虎属于同一个属。

zh: 我在公交车上丢了一只手套。

en: The story is about greed and its punishment.
zh: 这个故事讲的是贪婪及其惩罚。

zh: 她在门口迎接客人。

en: The news was greeted with cheers.

en: She bought a hank of red wool.
zh: 她买了一绞红毛线。

en: He watered the garden with a hose.
zh: 他用水管给花园浇水。

en: The dancers wore black hose.

en: The castle is an imposing building on the hill.
zh: 那座城堡是山上一座宏伟的建筑。

zh: 这种药膏有助于减轻皮肤炎症。

en: The city is a magnet for young people.

en: "Life is a journey" is a common metaphor.
zh: “人生是一段旅程”是一个常见的隐喻。

en: He became a millionaire before he was thirty.
zh: 他三十岁前就成了百万富翁。

en: The word "negro" is now considered offensive.
zh: “negro”这个词现在被认为带有冒犯性。

en: Please notify us if you change your address.
zh: 如果你更改了地址，请通知我们。

en: The contract was declared null and void.
zh: 这份合同被宣布无效。

en: The program returns a null value if the field is empty.
zh: 如果字段为空，程序就返回空值。

en: Oops, I've spilled my coffee!
zh: 哎呀，我把咖啡洒了！

en: The museum has a fine collection of oriental art.
zh: 这家博物馆收藏了许多精美的东方艺术品。

en: The two countries signed a peace pact.
zh: 两国签署了和平条约。

en: Safety is of paramount importance.
zh: 安全是最重要的。

en: Stop being so paranoid—nobody is watching you.
zh: 别疑神疑鬼了，没人在看你。

en: The patient showed paranoid symptoms.
zh: 这个病人表现出妄想症状。

en: He was a true patriot who loved his country.
zh: 他是一位真正热爱祖国的爱国者。

en: She is a generous patron of the arts.
zh: 她是一位慷慨的艺术赞助人。

en: The restaurant offers free parking for patrons.
zh: 这家餐厅为顾客提供免费停车。

en: Let's get some popcorn before the film starts.
zh: 电影开始前我们买点爆米花吧。

en: You can vote by proxy if you are away.
zh: 如果你不在，可以委托代理人投票。

en: Test scores are often used as a proxy for intelligence.
zh: 考试分数常被用作衡量智力的替代指标。

en: The office connects to the internet through a proxy.
zh: 办公室通过代理服务器连接互联网。

en: The study used quantitative methods to analyse the data.
zh: 这项研究采用定量方法分析数据。

en: She slowly regained her strength after the illness.
zh: 病后她慢慢恢复了体力。

en: I need to renew my passport this year.
zh: 我今年需要续签护照。

en: The two sides agreed to renew talks.
zh: 双方同意重新开始谈判。

en: The old pipes will be renewed next month.
zh: 旧水管下个月将被更换。

en: She closely resembles her mother.
zh: 她长得很像她妈妈。

en: The word "retarded" is now considered offensive.
zh: “retarded”这个词现在被认为有冒犯性。

en: Teachers told the students not to call ideas "retarded".
zh: 老师告诉学生不要把想法说成“白痴的”。

en: She loves retro clothes from the seventies.
zh: 她喜欢七十年代的复古服装。

en: The peasants led a revolt against the king.
zh: 农民们发动了反抗国王的起义。

en: The people revolted against the cruel ruler.
zh: 人民起来反抗残暴的统治者。

en: The smell of the rotten meat revolted me.
zh: 腐肉的气味让我感到恶心。

en: She was rightly proud of her work.
zh: 她理所当然地为自己的作品感到自豪。

en: There's a rumor that the shop is closing.
zh: 有传言说那家商店要关门了。

en: He is rumored to be leaving the team.
zh: 据传他要离开球队。

en: She put the saddle on the horse.
zh: 她把马鞍放到马背上。

en: Can you lower the saddle on my bike?
zh: 你能把我自行车的车座调低一点吗？

en: I don't want to be saddled with all the work.
zh: 我不想被所有这些工作拖累。

en: He saddled the horse and rode off.
zh: 他给马备好鞍，骑马走了。

en: She had only six years of schooling.
zh: 她只上过六年学。

en: Thousands of people visit the shrine every year.
zh: 每年有成千上万的人参拜这座神殿。

en: The singer's old home has become a shrine for fans.
zh: 这位歌手的故居已成为歌迷心中的圣地。

en: My sweater shrank in the wash.
zh: 我的毛衣洗缩水了。

en: She shrank back in fear when the dog barked.
zh: 狗叫时她吓得往后退缩。

en: He's been seeing a shrink for years.
zh: 他看心理医生已经好几年了。

en: The soldiers were warned about a sniper in the hills.
zh: 士兵们被警告山里有狙击手。

en: He enjoys long, solitary walks in the countryside.
zh: 他喜欢在乡间独自长时间散步。

en: There was not a solitary person on the street.
zh: 街上一个人也没有。

en: The prisoner was kept in solitary for a week.
zh: 那名囚犯被单独监禁了一周。

en: She felt deep sorrow when her dog died.
zh: 她的狗死了，她深感悲伤。

en: Life is full of joys and sorrows.
zh: 人生充满了欢乐和伤心事。

en: His words only stoked her anger.
zh: 他的话只是加剧了她的怒火。

en: He stoked the fire with more wood.
zh: 他又添了些柴，把火烧旺。

en: Both sides agreed to the termination of the contract.
zh: 双方同意终止合同。

en: He received a letter of termination from his boss.
zh: 他收到了老板发的解雇信。

en: She hurt her thigh while running.
zh: 她跑步时伤了大腿。

en: These plants thrive in warm, wet weather.
zh: 这些植物在温暖潮湿的天气里长得很茂盛。

en: Just ignore the trolls in the comments.

en: He was banned for trolling other users.
zh: 他因恶意挑衅其他用户而被封号。

en: In the story, a troll lived under the bridge.

en: The company will undertake the building of the new school.
zh: 这家公司将承担新学校的建设工作。

en: He undertook to pay the money back within a month.
zh: 他答应一个月内还钱。

en: She still has some unpaid bills.
zh: 她还有一些未付的账单。

en: She does unpaid work at the local hospital.
zh: 她在当地医院做义务工作。

en: His first attempt was unsuccessful.
zh: 他的第一次尝试失败了。

en: He wore a grey vest over his white shirt.
zh: 他在白衬衫外面穿了一件灰色马甲。

en: It's cold, so wear a vest under your shirt.

en: Power is vested in the elected council.
zh: 权力被授予选举产生的委员会。

en: Grape vines covered the sunny hills.
zh: 葡萄藤爬满了阳光充足的山坡。

zh: 这台笔记本电脑有两年保修。

en: How many yen is this ticket?

en: The computer has a fast CPU.
zh: 这台电脑有一个很快的处理器。

en: Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?
zh: 您想要靠窗的座位还是靠过道的座位？

en: Many people believe in an almighty God.
zh: 许多人信仰全能的上帝。

en: They prayed to the Almighty for help.

en: The shop sells sports apparel.

en: The dispute was settled by arbitration.

zh: 两位老师将监考这场考试。

en: The children looked for minibeasts in the garden.
zh: 孩子们在花园里寻找小虫子。

en: The sign had been mistranslated.
zh: 这个标志被翻译错了。

en: They motorized the old bicycle.
zh: 他们给那辆旧自行车装上了马达。

en: He drank a mugful of hot chocolate.
zh: 他喝了一大杯热巧克力。

en: He used an oilcan to oil the door.
zh: 他用油壶给门上油。

en: My uncle works on an oilrig in the North Sea.
zh: 我叔叔在北海的一座石油钻井平台上工作。

en: Panfry the fish for three minutes on each side.
zh: 鱼每面煎三分钟。

en: I have a penfriend in Australia.
zh: 我在澳大利亚有个笔友。

en: She bought a phonecard to call home.
zh: 她买了一张电话卡打电话回家。

en: We watched powerlessly as the house burned.
zh: 我们眼睁睁地看着房子烧毁，无能为力。

en: He drove riskily on the icy road.
zh: 他在结冰的路上冒险开车。

en: Use a soupspoon for the soup.
zh: 喝汤用汤匙。

en: We had barbecued spareribs for dinner.
zh: 我们晚饭吃了烤排骨。

en: Mum baked a spongecake for my birthday.
zh: 妈妈为我的生日烤了一个海绵蛋糕。

en: We spent a week on a sundrenched island.
zh: 我们在一个阳光充足的岛上度过了一周。

en: Read the tapescript after you listen.
zh: 听完后再看录音原文。

en: Grandma gave us a china teaset.
zh: 奶奶送给我们一套瓷茶具。

en: As a telecommuter, she rarely visits the office.
zh: 作为远程办公者，她很少去办公室。

en: More and more teleworkers live in the countryside.
zh: 越来越多的远程工作者住在乡下。

en: The vet tranquillized the horse before treating it.
zh: 兽医在治疗前给马注射了镇静剂。

en: He was trimly dressed in a dark suit.
zh: 他穿着一身深色西装，整洁利落。

en: Mummy, I've got a tummyache.
zh: 妈妈，我肚子疼。

en: The guards talked on walkietalkies.
zh: 保安用对讲机通话。

en: Throw the wrapper in the wastebin.
zh: 把包装纸扔进垃圾桶。

en: The doctor gave him morphine to ease the pain after surgery.
zh: 手术后医生给他注射了吗啡来缓解疼痛。

en: The guard gave the intruder a murderous look.
zh: 警卫对闯入者露出杀气腾腾的眼神。

en: Buddhists believe that nirvana ends the cycle of suffering.
zh: 佛教徒相信涅槃能终结苦难的轮回。

en: For a keen reader, this bookshop is pure nirvana.
zh: 对爱读书的人来说，这家书店简直就是天堂。

en: The army stored its ordnance in an underground depot.
zh: 军队把军火储存在一个地下仓库里。

en: She had an X-ray because of pelvic pain.
zh: 她因为骨盆疼痛去拍了X光片。

en: Water drains quickly through porous rock.
zh: 水很快就能渗过多孔的岩石。

en: Smugglers took advantage of the porous border.
zh: 走私者利用了漏洞百出的边境。

en: They registered the baby's birth with the local registrar.
zh: 他们到当地登记员那里为婴儿办理了出生登记。

en: Students should send their transcripts to the university registrar.
zh: 学生应把成绩单寄给大学的注册主任。

en: Cold weather can retard the growth of young plants.
zh: 寒冷的天气会延缓幼苗的生长。

en: "Retard" is now considered a very offensive word for a person.
zh: 用“弱智”称呼人如今被视为极具冒犯性。

en: Her happiness proved transient, and soon she felt sad again.
zh: 她的快乐转瞬即逝，很快她又难过起来。

en: The town has a large transient population of seasonal workers.
zh: 这个小镇有大量季节性的流动工人。

en: The shelter provides beds for transients passing through the city.
zh: 这个收容所为途经城市的过客提供床位。

en: Many window cleaners contain ammonia, so open a window.
zh: 许多玻璃清洁剂含有氨，所以要开窗通风。

en: The heart is analogous to a pump.
zh: 心脏类似于一个泵。

en: As a young man, he called himself an anarchist.
zh: 他年轻时自称是无政府主义者。

en: We bopped to the music all night at the party.
zh: 聚会上我们随着音乐跳了一整晚。

en: She bopped her brother on the head with a pillow.
zh: 她用枕头轻轻敲了一下弟弟的头。

en: My grandfather loves listening to old bop records.
zh: 我爷爷喜欢听老的比波普爵士乐唱片。

en: After the walk, the dog's fur was full of burrs.
zh: 散步回来后，狗的毛上粘满了刺果。

en: File off the burr after you cut the metal pipe.
zh: 切割金属管后要把毛刺锉掉。

en: He speaks with a soft Scottish burr.
zh: 他说话带着轻柔的苏格兰卷舌口音。

en: The school will celebrate its centennial next year.
zh: 这所学校明年将庆祝建校一百周年。

en: The city held a centennial parade last summer.
zh: 去年夏天，这座城市举行了百年纪念游行。

en: My car insurance has a deductible of 500 dollars.
zh: 我的汽车保险有500美元的免赔额。

en: Some business expenses are tax deductible.
zh: 一些业务开支可以抵税。

en: I bought a duff battery that died in a day.
zh: 我买了个差劲的电池，一天就没电了。

en: Get off your duff and help me clean up!
zh: 别坐着了，起来帮我打扫！

en: We need an equitable way to share the work.
zh: 我们需要一种公平的方式来分配工作。

en: Estrogen levels change as women get older.
zh: 随着女性年龄增长，雌激素水平会发生变化。

en: The farmer stores fodder for the cows in winter.
zh: 农夫为奶牛储存过冬的饲料。

en: Her strange neighbours provided fodder for her novels.
zh: 她那些古怪的邻居成了她小说的素材。

en: Don't be such a git and give me back my phone.
zh: 别那么讨厌，把手机还给我。
